welcome.title: Welcome to CatCheck
welcome.body: Take a quick look at the main features to start tracking your cat's litter color. You can skip at any time.

steps.dashboard: An overview of your cats, latest scans and scan reminders.
steps.scan: Photograph the color-indicator litter with the color chart to record your cat's pH.
steps.history: Review each cat's scans and pH trends over time.
steps.cats: Manage your cats' profiles: breed, age and profile photo.
steps.community: Read care tips and share experiences with other cat owners.
steps.map: Find vet clinics and emergency care near you.
steps.shop: Buy color-indicator litter and litter tray accessories.
steps.credits: Activate the code printed on your litter bag to get credits for scans.
steps.assistant: Ask about cat care, with cited sources so you can double-check. Information is for reference only and does not replace a veterinarian.
steps.notifications: Get scan reminders and important updates here.
steps.profile: Update your account, manage notifications and security, and replay this tour.

settings.title: Feature tour
settings.note: Automatically shows a short tour when you open Home. Turn it off if you don't want to see it again.
